chapter.heading: Praise to God, the Ruler of the EarthTo the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
chapter.v:
Oh, clap
your hands, all you peoples!Shout to God with the voice of triumph! [Ps. 45:13]

For the
Lord Most High is awesome;He is a great King over all the earth.

He will
subdue the peoples under us,And the nations under our feet. [Song 4:5]

He will
choose our inheritance for us,The excellence of Jacob whom He loves.Selah [Song 4:4]

God has
gone up with a shout,The Lord with the sound of a trumpet.

Sing praises
to God, sing praises!Sing praises to our King, sing praises!

For God
is the King of all the earth;Sing praises with understanding.

God reigns
over the nations;God sits on His holy throne.

The princes
of the people have gathered together,The people of the God of Abraham.For the shields of the earth belong to God;He is greatly exalted.
